result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **MailerLite**\. It offers the best balance of affordability, ease of use, professional email design and automation without being overly complicated.

However, there are a few excellent options depending on what your business needs.

## My top 5 email marketing tools

**1\. MailerLite**

(Best overall)

- Very easy to use
- Beautiful email templates
- Automated welcome emails and follow-ups
- Landing pages and signup forms
- Good value for money

Best for: Small businesses wanting to build and grow an email list.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$10–12/month.

[Visit MailerLite](https://www.mailerlite.com/)

**2\. Brevo**

(Best budget option)

- Email and SMS marketing
- Built-in CRM
- Automated campaigns
- Good for businesses with larger contact lists

Best for: Businesses wanting email marketing and customer management together.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$9/month.

[Visit Brevo](https://www.brevo.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Mailchimp New Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/A4pS92-0DG6f6UltfMLJ69yrHJwfeHXt0m29iGv6EnRV43IChNbudIRkwJjh2ykxj0QV3HVUYyTJQkivf3ra21uIa84OvzuFnINumiKho4l3Aml4nV6xTNsFFLFOXaQPsnTTdtbARb8gTwUMLY3c_rp9l1wfRV4on5IrszCtK2o5nkuy7NVTb4o6a9SXEood?purpose=fullsize)

- Beginner-friendly
- Lots of templates

Best for: Businesses wanting a well-known platform with lots of integrations.

Free plan available with limitations.

[Visit Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/)

![ActiveCampaign - Blue Ninja](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EouKh9P45dha8lf5y8rFcjosqmGPnqMhUC4vUxsIsmJOZKXfFv0WZ2M1Rt5aQTQVatptyFzb00u5rqUyyUt5nfAXNZcW3dYEUdrs0bSWR3k4b7jAtS4qbGi6ODF8iEsLzx8-yCF6Ei8Iq2gQO7peSlhUyHgt-4tOb8_yPRbh44WijrMMqO0EHfxwcZeCPQ-d?purpose=fullsize)

- Advanced email automation
- Customer segmentation
- Sales pipeline management
- Personalised customer journeys

Best for: Businesses wanting sophisticated marketing automation.

Paid plans; generally more expensive.

[Visit ActiveCampaign](https://www.activecampaign.com/)

---

![Klaviyo für Shopify Plus – Top E-Mail-Marketing Tool](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/8pv349744R5IAwklgNwietVYq8GpBv9LyUjhVIw7AlOkgTPpH4bMccrpK5bH38eHaYexCid-sYFqV9By7uoq5tXepf1YeN4TevlPerOd-gqto-IIe9mwNuIwkpszdifziLD-inBqotyckPSR2vk1zOCp8tCtIN1ap6PPE8AJKPJjb09XMO-7TUCEMC9bLBaC?purpose=fullsize)

- Excellent ecommerce integrations
- Abandoned cart emails
